title: pouteria lateriflora
intro: Pouteria lateriflora, commonly known as Brazilian cherry or mururé, is a plant species native to Brazil. It is a rich source of antioxidants, anti-inflammatory compounds, and other bioactive constituents that contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pouteria lateriflora include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
